message.text:
memopayload.Runner is not started by the server. RebuildMemoPayload runs synchronously from memo create and update handlers instead.

The memopayload runner's RunOnce exists but is not wired into server.go. Four goroutines in internal/webhook/webhook.go are started via package init, not server.Start. I am checking whether internal/scheduler is used anywhere.

The scheduler package is not used outside internal/scheduler.

The server explicitly starts the s3presign runner inside startBackgroundRunners. Webhook async workers are indirectly started via package init in internal/webhook when the webhook package loads. The server does not directly invoke these webhook goroutines.

memopayload.Runner is not started by the server. SSE hub is connection management, not a background runner. I am checking cmd/memos for additional runner starts.

Webhook workers start via `init()` in `internal/webhook` when the package is imported.

Only the S3 presign runner is explicitly started by `Server.Start` inside `startBackgroundRunners`. The webhook workers are not started by `Server.Start`; they launch via package initialization when the binary loads. The server package itself does not appear to drive any other background runners.

`memopayload.Runner` exists but is never launched as a background worker; `RebuildMemoPayload` runs synchronously on create and update.

The S3 presign runner triggers immediately on startup and then on a 12-hour ticker. The webhook workers trigger on event-driven channel dispatches via `PostAsync`, not on a schedule.

The `internal/scheduler` cron package is unused by the server.

`memopayload.NewRunner` is never invoked. Only `RebuildMemoPayload` is used.

`s3presign` is started by `server.Start`. Webhook workers run via `internal/webhook` initialization and are triggered by the `PostAsync` queue. They are background processes tied to the server binary but not launched through `Server.Start`.

`s3presign` runs once immediately on startup and then repeats every 12 hours via a `time.Ticker`.

The internal scheduler cron is unused outside its own tests and examples.
Checking for other background goroutines started at server initialization.
authenticator.go contains a go func likely for PAT usage recording, not a scheduled runner.

recordPATUsage is a per-request fire-and-forget operation, not a background runner.

s3presign is the only runner explicitly started by the server. It runs once at startup and again on a 12-hour ticker.

Webhook workers are also launched via init when the webhook package loads. Their trigger is an async channel on webhook events.

The cron scheduler in internal/scheduler is unused. memopayload.Runner was never started for batch rebuilds.
